steps.label: Metric table
steps.pseudocode: Compute the same metrics for each model.
steps.python:
VAL = {'baseline': (12, 10, 18, 110), 'logistic': (21, 12, 9, 108), 'tree': (24, 17, 6, 103)}   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) on 150 validation customers
def metrics(tp, fp, fn, tn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return {'accuracy': (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 'precision': p, 'recall': r, 'f1': 2 * p * r / (p + r)}
for name, counts in VAL.items():
    m = metrics(*counts)
    print(name, round(m['precision'], 2), round(m['recall'], 2), round(m['f1'], 2))
# prints: baseline 0.55 0.4 0.46
# prints: logistic 0.64 0.7 0.67
# prints: tree 0.59 0.8 0.68
